name: Lady Sarevess
summary: Within Blackfathom Deeps, Lady Sarevess works dark sorceries in the flooded ruins.

sections.title: A Grotto in the Deeps
sections.body: Lady Sarevess performs rituals in a flooded grotto within the Pool of Ask'ar. The Twilight's Hammer cultists haunt the sunken temple too, pursuing their own worship deeper in the cavern.

sections.title: Sorcery of the Tides
sections.body: Lady Sarevess commands elemental currents and crackling lightning. Loyal naga sentinels and summoned water elementals guard her sanctuary as she fights intruders who threaten her dark work.

faq.answer: Lady Sarevess dwells in the subterranean Pool of Ask'ar inside Blackfathom Deeps. The very twisted naga spellcaster dabbles in dark magic.

faq.q: Where can Lady Sarevess be found?
faq.answer: Lady Sarevess makes her lair in the Pool of Ask'ar, a flooded chamber in the early reaches of the Blackfathom Deeps temple complex along the Ashenvale coast.

faq.q: What powers does Lady Sarevess command?
faq.answer: Lady Sarevess wields water and elemental magic, including violent bursts of forked lightning, against anyone who enters her cove.

angles.text: As a night elf, the ruins Lady Sarevess inhabits were once a sacred temple of Elune. Her twisted naga kin defiling the waters of Ask'ar recalls the Sundering.
As a mage, you can see how highborne magical practices became raw, chaotic lightning and tidal sorcery after centuries of oceanic corruption.
